name: Improved Channel Spirit
body:
Your connection with your favored spirit grows.

Prerequisite(s): Channel Spirit, Spirit Ridden, Charisma 13, character level 3rd

Benefit(s): Select one medium spirit you gained with Channel Spirit. Whenever you channel that spirit, you gain the lesser spirit power it grants. For the purposes of using this power, your medium level is equal to your character level -2.

Special: You may gain this feat more than once. Every time, it applies to a different spirit selected with Channel Spirit.
